decisions.reason: The particle therapy water phantom is still being rolled out, with US release planned for Q1/2019, so its uncertainty is unresolved and the option is worth keeping.
Small volume chambers cost little to keep in a dosimetry catalog and still have growing demand for small-field dosimetry, so keeping the option is cheap.
This is a second small volume chamber with some overlap, but carrying it costs little and one year gives no evidence of failure.
A standard clinical ionization chamber is a core catalog item with low carrying cost and steady demand.
This relative dosimetry chamber complements the firm's water phantom systems at minimal cost, and its value is not yet resolved.
This thimble chamber is a low-cost addition to an established measurement line, with no sign that its value will not be realized.
